packages.name: Graphite monitor
packages.description: A plain graphite bezel around Game Boy and Game Boy Advance games, in place of the built-in handheld frames. Shows with Screen frame set to Auto.
packages.author: pocket-ui

packages.name: Titillium type
packages.description: Titillium Web for every title and line of text in pocket-ui, in place of Barlow. Remove it to go back.
packages.author: pocket-ui

packages.name: Storage report
packages.description: Shows the free space on the card and how many files your game folders hold. Also listed under Tools in Settings.
packages.author: pocket-ui

packages.name: Test pattern core
packages.description: A tiny libretro core that draws colour bars and a square you move with the D-pad. Checks that cores from the store load.
packages.author: pocket-ui
